title: GH-3: Labels, issue templates, a GitHub Project board; load this file as issues
body:
**Owner:** Project mgr
**Trigger:** GH-2
**Done check:** Every row here is an issue with owner, trigger and done check
**Status:** closed

Source of truth: `docs/roadmap.md` (item GH-3). Every closed item proposes a plus: file it as a new issue labeled `plus`.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 273.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
